text:
[LTIM.2.7.2] When a `within`-windowed positive pattern justifies a `logical` fact
([LLOG]), the justification lapses as the window expires: on the pump
at which the matched fact falls outside `<dur>`, the pattern no longer matches and
**the engine must retract** the justified logical fact — truth maintenance per the
justification-linkage principle ([LLOG.15.1]) — emitting `fact_retract`.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_clocked
idris.note: The clause's retraction is the cascade after the re-time, by definition: a windowed activation the re-time ended has its rows dropped and what they alone supported retracted. That the justified fact is retracted is a consequence of the definition and Rete/NetworkTms.idr's phase; the theorem is Rete/NetworkWindowLapse.idr's `ltim_2_7_2__lapsed_justification_retracted`.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__closing_ends_clocked
idris.note: 'The pattern no longer matches': on the tick at which the window shuts, the re-timed chain holds no activation of the match, so the justification has nothing to stand on. The retraction that follows is the cascade's.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__no_cascade_is_the_retime
idris.note: The complementary case: when no justified fact rests on an activation the tick ended, the cascade the clause's retraction runs in touches nothing and the tick's result is the re-timed state.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_clocked_inv
idris.note: The cascade for the activations the re-time ended, run to its fixpoint, keeps the invariant: the rows of the ended activations go and the facts they alone supported are retracted.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ended_fired_cascade
idris.note: The clause's retraction executed: the ended activation's logical fact, which it alone supported, is retracted at the tick that ended it.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__closing_ends
idris.note: 'The pattern no longer matches': on the tick at which the window shuts, no activation of the match is left for a justification to stand on. The retraction that follows is the cascade's, on the engines with the table (Rete/NetworkClocked.idr).

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__alphas_two
idris.note: Two alphas, kinds 0 and 1. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapsed_fact_retracted
idris.note: AND THE JUSTIFIED FACT IS RETRACTED WHEN THE WINDOW CLOSES: after the pump at 1 the Occupied stands beside the Sensor; after the pump at 4, whose re-time ends the match and whose cascade drops the row, the Sensor alone is live. 'The engine must retract the justified logical fact' on the tick at which the matched fact falls outside `<dur>`. Executed on the whole engine; the general theorem is Rete/NetworkWindowLapse.idr's.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__life
idris.note: THE LIFECYCLES OF THE `within` FIXTURE: kind 0 the Sensor, an entity; kind 1 the Occupied it justifies, a relation -- `logical`, so the emit records a row. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__occupy
idris.note: `occupy`: `Sensor within 3_s`, emitting Occupied logical -- logical/LTIM.2.5.1_logical_within_fires_once's rule, the node loaded with the test at the sample (0, 0). A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__within_fires_once
idris.note: A `within` THAT JUSTIFIES A LOGICAL EMIT FIRES ONCE WHEN IT OPENS AND NOT WHILE IT HOLDS: the Sensor asserted at 0 under `within 3`; the pump at 0 fires and emits, the pump at 1 fires nothing (the match persists across the tick), the pump at 4 fires nothing. Executed: `[[(0, True)], [], []]`.

idris.name: Ltim_2_7_2__justified_only_by_ended
idris.note: JUSTIFIED ONLY BY ENDED ACTIVATIONS: every row targeting the id has an activation that is not live on the engine's chains. 'The justification lapses', for every justification of the fact at once: the clause's case is one `within` pattern justifying the fact, and the predicate covers it with any other justifiers lapsed too, since a fact another live activation still justifies keeps that justification.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__cascade_drops
idris.note: THE CASCADE RETRACTS A FACT EVERY JUSTIFICATION OF WHICH HAS LAPSED, with any number of phases after the first: the first phase ends the fact's rows and retracts its id, and no later phase puts a fact back. Under unique ids, so that retracting the id retracts the fact and no other. Stated on Rete/NetworkTms.idr's `iret_12_2__phase_n_net`, so the fuel plays no part.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__dead_row_is_ended
idris.note: A row whose activation is not live is among the rows the phase ends, whatever its target's liveness: the ending test is `not (live && target_live)`.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__kept_count_zero
idris.note: A KEPT ROW TARGETS NO LAPSED ID: the id's `justif_count` against the rows the phase keeps is zero, because a kept row's activation is live and every row targeting the id has one that is not.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_ids_unique
idris.note: EXECUTED: the literal's three ids are fresh by computation, so unique. [IRET.4.4] on the fixture's state, which the theorem takes as a premise.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_only_dead
idris.note: EXECUTED: every row targeting the kind-2 fact has lapsed -- there is one, and it has.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_row_dead
idris.note: EXECUTED: the row has lapsed on the re-timed chains -- B's gate shuts at 1, and after the re-time the terminal holds no fired activation of the row's identity. The theorem's premise, inhabited.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_rows
idris.note: EXECUTED: the fixture's table as a literal -- B's one row, rule 0 over the kind-1 fact, justifying the kind-2 fact.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_state
idris.note: THE STATE THE RE-TIME STAGE STARTS FROM at Rete/NetworkFrameRetime.idr's fixture: after the run in which B's logical emit recorded its row, the tick to 1 advanced and swept (nothing) and has not yet re-timed. `ltim_2_5_1__fired_then_tick` is the re-time stage applied to it, by definition. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapse_wm
idris.note: EXECUTED: the fixture's working memory as a literal -- the kind-0 input, A's kind-1 fact, B's kind-2 fact.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__lapsed_justification_retracted
idris.note: THE LAPSED JUSTIFICATION IS RETRACTED. For every program, every list of timed tests and every clocked state with unique fact ids: an id some dependency row targets, every row targeting which has lapsed on the chains the tick re-times at the state's clock (no fired activation of the row's identity remains), carries no fact in working memory after the re-time stage. The clause's 'the engine must retract the justified logical fact', for any program and any justifier the tick ends. 'The pattern no longer matches' is the premise, which `ltim_2_5_1__closing_ends_clocked` discharges for a window that shuts. Applied at `ltim_2_7_2__retracted_at_the_fixture` with every hypothesis discharged by computation.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__retracted_at_the_fixture
idris.note: THE THEOREM AT THE FIXTURE: the kind-2 fact is not in working memory after the tick that shut B's gate -- the conclusion Rete/NetworkFrameRetime.idr's `ltim_2_5_1__ended_fired_cascade` computed, reached here through the theorem with every hypothesis discharged on the literals.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_2__zeroed_holds_it
idris.note: THE LAPSED ID IS ZEROED: when the phase ends rows, an id some row targets and every row of which has lapsed is among the ids the phase retracts -- it is a target of an ended row and its count against the kept rows is 0.
